Workshop / 2026-10-28

A home for the things I'm building

Dive planning, gas labels, a connected dive community, and the work that happens between dives.

RunTime Dive Systems brings my diving projects together in one place.

The Lake Washington DPV Planner, Gas Label Studio, and Innerspace Scuba Society each solve a different part of the diving workflow. This site is the place to find them and follow what I'm working on next.

From the workshop

I'll use this log for project updates, build photos, and notes from the process. That includes the things that work and the things that need another iteration.

TriCell, my three-cell oxygen analyzer project, will also have a home here as development continues.

Rooted in the Pacific Northwest

Cold water, wrecks, giant Pacific octopuses, and sixgill sharks are part of what makes diving here worth the effort. That is the world behind RunTime.
